purpose: Retrospective development diagnostic; no confirmatory inference or external tuning
selection: fit-only standardization and training; maximize calibration AUROC, ties first C; external never selects
limitations: Historical audit and ComGenVid pool have already been inspected and used for exploration.
Legacy features were float16 cached then summarized in float32; external extraction used float32. Precision equivalence remains unverified.
MSVD filename stems approximate parent IDs; unknown fake ancestry and cross-source ancestry remain unresolved.
Source-conditional shuffling probes pairing while retaining class/source feature information; its tail fraction is descriptive, not a causal randomization p-value.
Repeated seeds of a deterministic logistic regression do not establish training stability.
